token_set.name: Across the Pond
token_set.description: In October 1997, the NHL made history by playing its first regular-season games outside North America, in Tokyo, Japan. Since then, numerous games have been held overseas, including the NHL Premiere Series and the current NHL Global Series across Europe. Across the Pond celebrates some of the most memorable highlights from these international games, featuring both retired and active players. Relives unforgettable plays like a hat trick scored in a home country, a game-deciding shootout save, or a first career goal in this globetrotting Core set.

description:
Playing in the 2018 NHL Global Series held in Helsinki, Finland, Patrik Laine netted a hat trick in front of his home country fans. The Finland native, born in Tampere just north of Helsinki, had a night to remember. His first goal came on a Winnipeg power play in the latter half of the second period, where his wrist shot went upstairs to beat the goaltender. Early in the third, during a 5-on-3 advantage, Laine blasted home a one-timer for his second goal, which later proved to be the game-winner. He capped off the evening with an empty-netter to seal the game, delighting the Finnish crowd who threw their hats onto the ice in celebration.

description:
During the 2010-11 season, no goaltender played more games than Cam Ward, who appeared in 74 games, winning 37 of them and posting a .923 save percentage. In the 2010 NHL Premiere Series held in Helsinki, Finland, Ward stopped Antti Miettinen's final shootout attempt to give Carolina back-to-back wins over the Minnesota Wild. Ward had a busy night, stopping 41 shots, in addition to his three shootout saves, in the 2-1 Carolina victory. The 2006 Conn Smythe Trophy winner spent all but one of his 14 NHL seasons with the Hurricanes.

description:
In Stockholm, Sweden, during a two-game set against the Pittsburgh Penguins, Dany Heatley scored twice in the second game. After netting a goal in the second period to give his team a 1-0 lead, Heatley added another in the third with a well-executed one-timer. His second goal proved to be the game-winner.

display_meta.name: Across the Pond
display_meta.description: In October 1997, the NHL made history by playing its first regular-season games outside North America, in Tokyo, Japan. Since then, numerous games have been held overseas, including the NHL Premiere Series and the current NHL Global Series across Europe. Across the Pond celebrates some of the most memorable highlights from these international games, featuring both retired and active players. Relives unforgettable plays like a hat trick scored in a home country, a game-deciding shootout save, or a first career goal in this globetrotting Core set.
